name: main-stage-or-bust
description: MAIN STAGE OR BUST roll-and-write: print-and-play + web game

scripts.test: node --test app/engine.test.js tests/narrative.test.js && node tests/smoke-season.js && node app/sim.js 10000 1
scripts.start: node -e "require('http').createServer((q,s)=>{const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');let u=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);if(u.endsWith('/'))u+='index.html';let f=p.join(process.cwd(),u);fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);s.end('nope')}else{s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':f.endsWith('.js')?'text/javascript':f.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':'text/html'});s.end(d)}})}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('MAIN STAGE OR BUST game: http://localhost:8080/app/ | print: http://localhost:8080/print/sheet.html'))"
